title: AI Shipcheck configuration
description: Optional configuration for AI Shipcheck. Every field has a sensible default; the zero-config path is the supported one.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion.

exclude.description: Extra paths to skip, using .gitignore syntax, relative to the scan root.

rules.description: Per-rule overrides, keyed by rule id. Run `ai-shipcheck rules` to list them.

oneOf.description: Enable the rule even if its category is disabled.

severity.description: Override how much a finding from this rule costs.

disabledCategories.description: Whole categories to skip. A disabled category is excluded from the score entirely.

minScore.description: Exit with code 1 when the overall score is below this.

failOn.description: Exit with code 1 when a finding of this severity or worse is reported.

respectGitignore.description: Honour .gitignore files while walking the tree.

limits.description: Resource ceilings that bound a scan. Raise with care.
